bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Config.Image}}')" = create-videobot:replyfree-c87ef8f6 || exit 63
base=fb2f26a6a9a7811213891f715ad6c225b5a6f00a
git fetch origin refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$base" || exit 65
for p in src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs;do
 source_hash="$(git show "$base:$p" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 live_hash="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 if test "$source_hash" != "$live_hash";then echo VIDEO_LIVE_FILE_HAS_UNMERGED_DIFF; exit 66;fi
done
echo VIDEO_LIVE_WIZARD_UI_BASELINE_MATCH=PASS
